description:
Review of `explorer-emit-comparison-artifact-from-pipeline` surfaced a
divergence that was explicitly called out in the parent TODO's
anti_patterns ("DO NOT compute platform display labels in two places")
but had to be deferred because the second implementation lives in
`core/visualization/` which was in that TODO's `do_not_modify` scope.

Two disambiguators exist today:

**A. Pipeline - `benchbox/core/explorer_pipeline/transformer.py`**
  `_disambiguate_platform_labels` (roughly lines 553-615).  Priority
  order: driver_version → execution_mode → scale_factor → run_date.
  Suffix format: ``v{x}`` for driver, ``({mode})`` for mode,
  ``SF{x:g}`` for scale.

**B. CLI visualizer - `benchbox/core/visualization/result_plotter.py`**
  (roughly lines 68-149).  Priority order: scale_factor → execution_mode
  → driver_version.  Suffix format: ``SF={x}``, raw ``{v}`` appended for
  driver.

The differences mean that the same two results can render with
different labels in the CLI vs the explorer.  The fix is to extract a
single disambiguator - the pipeline version is already parity-tested
and matches the explorer's expectations - and have `result_plotter`
import and call it.

This was deliberately deferred from the parent TODO because changing
`core/visualization/` was out of scope there.  It is purely a
consistency cleanup - no user-visible bug unless a user cross-checks
the CLI's rendered labels against the explorer's.

anti_patterns.dont: change the pipeline's disambiguator output format
anti_patterns.instead: only move the code, do not edit it
anti_patterns.why: parity fixtures pin the current strings

anti_patterns.dont: keep both implementations by introducing a feature flag
anti_patterns.why: that preserves the drift this TODO exists to remove

preserves.behavior: CLI rendering of result_plotter.py stays visually unchanged for the single-result case (no disambiguation suffix)
Pipeline-emitted ComparisonArtifact labels continue to match the parity fixtures in tests/parity/fixtures/comparison_artifact_*.json
